$comment: The internal tooling (cli/, scripts/) typechecks separately from the library.
It is a separate project because tsconfig.json's include is what the library
build and the vitest run see, and the tooling has different needs: node types,
and no place in dist/. Keeping it out of tsconfig.build.json's rootDir is the
point — the CLI is never published.
These scripts run under tsx rather than node directly. The library's own
imports are extensionless because it is built for bundlers, so neither src/
nor the emitted dist/ resolves under plain node ESM.
src is included rather than referenced so the scripts typecheck against the
real sources they import, not against a possibly-stale dist.
web/ and scripts/ are deliberately NOT here — each carries its own tsconfig.
The scene page is browser code needing the DOM lib and the WebGPU types, and
the Playwright driver needs both its own types and DOM types for the code it
evaluates inside the page. Neither is what this Node-typed project provides.
